retention.title: Data Retention
retention.desc: Control how long request logs and metrics data are retained. Metrics beyond the detail threshold are aggregated into 10-minute buckets.
retention.rangeError: Please enter an integer between {min} and {max}
retention.requestLogsHint: Complete request/response logs stored in files. Used for debugging and audit. Deleted automatically after retention period.
retention.metricsDetailHint: Full-resolution metrics (per-request TTFT, TPS, token counts). Beyond this window, data is aggregated into 10-minute buckets by provider + model.
retention.metricsExceedsLog: Metrics detail days must not exceed log retention days

storage.title: Storage Management
storage.desc: Monitor database size and configure auto-cleanup thresholds
storage.minValueError: Please enter a value no less than {min}
storage.logExceedsDbError: Log table limit should not exceed database limit

importExport.title: Config Import/Export
importExport.desc: Export current config or restore from file
importExport.importWarning: Import will overwrite current providers, mappings, keys and other config. Security settings (password, JWT) will be preserved.
